skills.name: grill-before-building
skills.description: Clarify the user's outcome, constraints, domain language, and acceptance criteria before non-trivial design or implementation work.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Implement or change behavior through a focused red-green-refactor loop with regression tests and deterministic verification.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Diagnose defects and regressions using reproducible evidence, competing hypotheses, instrumentation, and a regression test before changing code.

skills.name: independent-code-review
skills.description: Review a proposed diff independently for specification coverage, correctness, maintainability, security, and operational risk before it is merged.

skills.name: karpathy-engineering-discipline
skills.description: Reduce coding-agent mistakes by thinking before coding, choosing simplicity, making surgical changes, and defining verifiable goals.

skills.name: ponytail-minimal-change
skills.description: Minimize code and complexity by checking whether a change is needed, already solved, or supported by existing platform features before adding implementation.

skills.name: secure-skill-admission
skills.description: Assess third-party agent skills before admission by checking provenance, license, scripts, tool requests, data access, and execution risk.

skills.name: claude-runtime-engineering
skills.description: Implement Claude API or Managed Agents integrations through current official documentation, explicit adapter contracts, and fail-closed runtime eligibility checks.

skills.name: research-first-engineering
skills.description: Research unfamiliar libraries, APIs, security-sensitive behavior, and architecture choices using primary sources before implementation.

skills.name: release-readiness
skills.description: Verify a change through deterministic checks, independent review, security gates, migration safety, and founder-controlled release approval.

skills.name: market-research-briefing
skills.description: Produce evidence-led market and company research briefs with primary sources, dated claims, counter-evidence, and explicit uncertainty.

skills.name: client-discovery-requirements
skills.description: Turn discovery conversations and approved context into validated business needs, constraints, requirements, acceptance criteria, and open questions.

skills.name: proposal-sow-drafting
skills.description: Draft evidence-based proposals and statements of work from approved discovery, service catalog, scope, assumptions, and commercial inputs.

skills.name: client-communication-drafting
skills.description: Draft clear, accurate client and prospect communications using approved facts, consent context, tone, and escalation rules without sending them.

skills.name: project-delivery-coordination
skills.description: Coordinate delivery work through traceable requirements, scoped tasks, dependencies, owners, milestones, risks, and evidence-backed status.

skills.name: finance-operations-analysis
skills.description: Analyze agency budgets, project costs, estimates, receivables, and variance using traceable inputs and explicit currency handling.

skills.name: marketing-content-planning
skills.description: Plan evidence-led agency marketing content around audience needs, positioning, channel fit, measurable goals, and truthful claims.

skills.name: risk-and-policy-review
skills.description: Identify operational, privacy, security, legal and delivery risks, map them to existing controls, and escalate decisions outside agent authority.

skills.name: agentic-build-loop
skills.description: Turn a bounded engineering objective into a reviewed specification, acceptance tests, implementation plan, maker-checker cycle, and verified change.

skills.name: operating-loop-design
skills.description: Design recurring agent workflows with explicit triggers, durable state, objective gates, budgets, hard stops, escalation and recovery before scheduling.

skills.name: connector-security-review
skills.description: Review tools and connectors for provenance, blast radius, least privilege, data scope, prompt-injection exposure, approval gates and permission re-audit.

skills.name: operational-learning-capture
skills.description: Convert completed work into scoped, evidence-backed lessons with provenance, confidence, review and controlled promotion into reusable agency knowledge.
